none: PAS NLM-F21677: Roman Coin: Sestertius of Severus Alexander
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Sestertius, probably of Severus Alexander (222-235), mint of Rome issue of 225, RIC volume 4 part 2 no. 424. Obverse description: Head right. Obverse inscription: [--]EVER[--]. Reverse description: Mars advancing right with spear aslant, S C in field. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, citing Sear volume 2 no. 7989, RIC no. 424. Diameter: 30.2mmm, Weight: 15.73gms, die axis: 12
